'''İmişli Futbol Klubu''' ({{IPA|az|imiʃli|pron}}) is an [[Azerbaijan]]i professional [[football (soccer)|football]] club based in [[Imishli]] that participates in the [[Azerbaijan Premier League]] after promotion from the [[Azerbaijan First Division]] in 2025. 

Imishli is a [[Phoenix club (sports)|phoenix club]] of the former [[MKT Araz FK]] founded in 2004, which was dissolved in 2018."}}
